history.period: Modern (established 29 March 1981, per the temple's own description on TripAdvisor)
history.summary: The Gayatri Mandir on B Road, Sector 9 (also listed as Sector 9/A), is a Gayatri Parivar shrine founded on 29 March 1981 by Pandit Shriram Sharma Acharya, according to the temple's own description on TripAdvisor. It is known for its peaceful ambience and spacious premises and for its annual Navami (Navmi) Puja, during which khichdi prasad is distributed to devotees. The temple serves as a spiritual oasis for devotees in the steel city; beyond the self-described founding date, no independent historical documentation was found in the sources consulted (flag: verify the 1981 date with the temple trust).

town_description: Bokaro Steel City is a planned industrial city in Bokaro district, Jharkhand, built around the Bokaro Steel Plant, one of India's major steel plants. Its numbered sectors host a large migrant workforce and community from across India.
